manifest.limitations: RSS/private/virtual are process accounting, not native allocation attribution. VM categories/allocation stacks/GPU driver residency are not sampled. Native resource counters describe existing owner fields. GC and readbacks invalidate FPS interpretation. Replay-only and full Studio UI are NOT_RUN.
